From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up & scheduling demo - FinPath

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand FinPath's priorities and constraints. Quick recap from our conversation: 

- Primary use case: embeddings-driven KB search + support triage
- Key constraints: PII redaction, on-prem deployment option for regulated data, target latency ~50ms P50 for retrieval steps
- Success metrics: reduce time-to-first-answer, reduce escalations to L2 by 30%

Next steps / asks:
1) Schedule a 60-minute demo + technical deep dive where our Solutions Engineer can walk through integration patterns, latency/cost tradeoffs, and security controls.
2) Please loop in Security and Procurement so we can address questions live (we find that solves most procurement/security blockers).

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Feb 23, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Feb 24, 13:00–14:00
- Thu Feb 25, 09:00–10:00

If any of those work, I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a short one-pager on our deployment options for your review.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & scheduling demo - FinPath

Thanks Marissa — really appreciate the recap. Wed Feb 24 13:00–14:00 PST works best for our team. I’ve looped in Sarah (Security) and Dev (Procurement) so they can join the deep dive and flag any required artifacts. Liam from engineering may also attend to discuss integration constraints.

A few quick notes from our side:
- Security will want a SOC2 overview + details on data-in-transit and at-rest encryption, and whether KV/cache can be configured for customer-only tenancy.
- Procurement will likely request an initial SOW + estimated pricing bands and an NDA in place.

If you can invite your SE and someone from your security/compliance team, that would be great.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product | FinPath
alex.johnson@finpath.com
